probe.question: Have we ever coupled anything that looks like BrC1=CC=C(OC)C=C1 before?
forbids_claims: 'no prior work found' or equivalent, when 264 records on this exact halide are seeded
a count of matching records stated without any identifier a reader could check
probe.direction: 4-bromoanisole is one of fifteen aryl halides on the seeded Buchwald-Hartwig amination plates, with 264 records behind it and two sibling halides (the chloride and the iodide of the same anisole) on the same grid. A good answer finds them, says roughly how many and what varied, and points at something identifiable. A "no" here is a retrieval defect, not an honest absence.
